tool_input.description: Write compareExchange implementation, format, and build

result:
The `compareExchange` implementation is written in `crates/kahvi-builtins/src/atomics/compare_exchange.rs`, but I have not built it or run the test262 target. Bash was denied in this session, so `cargo build`, `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy` and `./t262 built-ins/Atomics/compareExchange/` never ran. I checked the helper signatures by reading the source, and the file is the only one changed.

The file follows the spec steps as comments, and it reuses the existing support helpers (`validate_atomic_access_on_integer_typed_array`, `coerce`, `revalidate_atomic_access`, `numeric_to_raw_bytes`, `raw_bytes_to_numeric`). Two things to check when it builds:
- The `.expect("not detached")` lines follow the pattern in `support/atomics.rs`. The buffer is attached at that point because revalidation has already run.
- The formatting of the long slice expressions was not run through `cargo fmt`, so the fmt check may want a small reflow.

For the shared-buffer branch (steps 13–14), the single-agent engine does the same read, compare and conditional store as the non-shared path, which the step comments say. No helper was missing, so nothing was added outside the file.
